notes: 点 × 立即执行待推送/待拉取：0.4.05 依赖前端信标 + 2 分钟预排，用户在两次复查之间点 × 仍会漏。0.4.06 把「用户在关窗」这个判断搬到后端：新增常驻窗口监视（250ms 采样 DeepSeek Harness 的可见窗口数，最小化不算），曾经有窗口且连续 4 拍（约 1 秒）归零即认定点 ×，当场判一次 drift、排好 watcher，确有活要干才强杀残留进程族让 watcher 立刻开工（无待同步不误杀）；前端信标与 2 分钟预排保留为双保险。post-exit wait 同步收紧：可见窗口归零 3 拍即开工，不再等 60 秒批次年龄；过期 watcher 让位判据收紧到「等待超 5 分钟且从未见过窗口」，避免把刚排好、正要开工的 watcher 误让掉。前提不变：需勾选「启动时自动拉取」/「退出时自动推送」。
notesEn: Click × now executes pending push/pull immediately. 0.4.05 still relied on the frontend beacon plus a 2-minute pre-queue, so clicking × between two checks could still miss. 0.4.06 moves the 'user is closing' decision to the backend: a resident window watcher samples the visible DeepSeek Harness window count every 250ms (minimized counts as visible); once a window has been seen and the count stays 0 for 4 consecutive samples (~1s), it is treated as the × click — drift is checked, the watcher is queued, and the residual process family is force-killed only when there is real work to do (no needless kill when nothing is pending). The frontend beacon and the periodic pre-queue remain as backups. post-exit wait also tightened: 3 zero-window samples is enough to start work instead of waiting for the 60s batch age, and the stale-watcher yield rule now requires >5 minutes of waiting with no window ever seen, so a freshly queued watcher is no longer yielded away. Prerequisite unchanged: the corresponding auto pull/push switch must be on.
